name: Twilio Segment
tagline: Customer data platform with tracking, profiles, destinations, and APIs.
shortDescription: Segment provides tracking APIs, Protocols, Profiles, Destinations, Warehouses, and source/destination management.
agentSummary: Agents can send events, inspect schemas, and manage customer data pipelines when PII and governance controls are clear.
bestFor: Event pipelines, CDP workflows, analytics routing, and customer profile data.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Customer data, PII, and destination fanout require governance and approval. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public plan pricing, often MTU/event-volume based.
authModel: Write keys, OAuth/API tokens, workspace permissions, source/destination credentials.
browserSupport: Workspace UI is central for schema, destination, and debugger review.

capabilities.detail: Segment APIs cover tracking, workspace config, sources, destinations, and profiles.
Docs include tracking APIs, destination docs, Protocols, and Personas/Profiles concepts.
Pricing is public at high level, with usage and plan details varying.
Workspace UI is central for schema, destination, and debugger review.
